name: kotobase-query
description: kotobase-query bridge -- transitive npm dep of kotoba-lang/arrangement (materialize target, via multiformats.core's @noble/hashes/sha2.js use) needed to load arrangement.core under nbb. NOTE: io-multiformats' own package.json also declares a "hashes": "2.0.1" dependency, but nothing in its source actually requires the npm "hashes" package (only "@noble/hashes/sha2.js") and no matching npm registry version exists -- that entry is vestigial/broken upstream and deliberately NOT mirrored here.
